function.title: execute_code
function.name: execute_code
function.description: Run Python code that calls Hermes tools programmatically. Use when you need 3+ tool calls with logic between them: filtering/reducing large outputs before they enter context, branching, or loops.

code.description: Python code to execute. Import tools with `from hermes_tools import web_search, terminal, ...` and print your final result to stdout.

reset.description: Discard the kernel's persistent state and start fresh before running this code.

function.title: web_search
function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for real-time information, technical docs, and latest news across providers.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web. May include site: and exact keywords.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.
